a.title: Exception-led metadata with stable details
a.mechanism: Suppress only safely redundant metadata; always show overdue/divergent dates and keep labeled Details stable at each scope. Unknown or divergent context remains visible; Details is always explicit. Retain dates when context cannot be proven identical. Use selected reference context, never wall-clock assumptions. Omit only context proven redundant; retain uncertain and overdue dates. Retain uncertain context and make Details a stable local route.
a.visible: Completion, title, exceptional dates, exact selected period and active scope/filter context.
a.disclosed: All nonexception metadata remains in Detalles; page/section options and summary preserve every statistic and edit action.
a.access: 44px nonoverlapping targets, scoped labels, keyboard disclosure, visible focus/return, 320px wrapping and reduced motion.
a.benefit: Reduces repeated signals while keeping unusual obligations visible.
a.risk: A mistaken context comparison could suppress a needed date.
a.verification: Test mixed dates, overdue tasks, inherited frequencies and history; verify details always reveals complete values.

b.title: Steady metadata rail
b.mechanism: Keep one stable summary rail below each title; use a simple Details label for sparse metadata and remeasure expansion. Re-measure virtualized rows when local details expand. Skip empty rails and retain row measurements. Do not reserve space for empty metadata. Omit empty rails and verify expanded row measurements.
b.visible: Title, completion, exact period, active scope and wrapping summary.
b.disclosed: Rail opens all metadata with direct duration/price/date/frequency editing and time-of-day cycling; section/page rails expose breakdowns and scope controls. Preserve all existing data and callback semantics.
b.access: 44px nonoverlapping targets, scoped labels, keyboard disclosure, visible focus/return, 320px wrapping and reduced motion.
b.benefit: Stable control positions support fast scanning as data changes.
b.risk: Reserved rail space can waste room on sparse tasks.
b.verification: Verify empty metadata, changing completion/counts, subtask totals, menus and virtualized row sizing.
